items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I don't know if George ever played with anybody straight... I don't remember if I ever seen him do that.

ctx.x: Everybody, anybody. I don't know if George ever played with anybody straight, I mean, as a team, you know. I don't remember if I ever seen him do that.
Well, who was your drummer with the jazz babies?
